label: CADC launch, PayTrie FINTRAC-licensed CAD stablecoin
Canada's Stablecoin Act receives royal assent; Bank of Canada to supervise
note: Enacted in Bill C-15 (S.C. 2026, c. 3). Non-financial-institution issuers of fiat-backed stablecoins must register with the Bank of Canada; operative provisions await a Governor in Council order, and Finance Canada expects the framework in force in 2027 (canada.ca stablecoin framework page, 2026-03-31). The Act (ss. 35, 37, 46, 48) requires par redemption, a reserve of the reference currency or high-quality liquid assets, and periodic reports carrying an independent certified accountant's opinion on the reserve. Section 12 exempts issuers that are financial institutions (Bank Act s. 2 definition). Pharos records Loon Payments Inc. only as a FINTRAC-registered money services business, with no financial-institution charter on record, so CADC appears in scope.
